_comment: Questions de benchmark. 'expected' = reponse attendue (verite terrain). 'cypher' = requete de reference pour le mode Graph Analytics. 'category' aide a analyser ou chaque approche est forte.

questions.question: Qui a realise le film Nebula ?
Dans quels films a joue Lea Vidal ?
questions.cypher: MATCH (:Person {name:'Lea Vidal'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(f:Film) RETURN f.name AS reponse

questions.question: Quel realisateur a dirige un film dans lequel joue Marcus Bonnet ?
questions.cypher: MATCH (:Person {name:'Marcus Bonnet'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(f:Film)<-[:DIRECTED]-(r:Person) RETURN DISTINCT r.name AS reponse

questions.question: Quels acteurs ont joue dans un film produit par Lumiere Studios ?
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(f:Film)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(:Studio {name:'Lumiere Studios'}) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS reponse

questions.question: Dans quel genre est le film realise par Yasmine Khalil dans lequel joue Lea Vidal ?
questions.cypher: MATCH (:Person {name:'Yasmine Khalil'})-[:DIRECTED]->(f:Film)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(g:Genre), (:Person {name:'Lea Vidal'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(f) RETURN g.name AS reponse

questions.question: Quel realisateur a realise le plus de films ?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(f:Film) RETURN r.name AS reponse, count(f) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Avec quels acteurs Nina Caron a-t-elle joue ?
questions.cypher: MATCH (:Person {name:'Nina Caron'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(f:Film)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Person) WHERE a.name <> 'Nina Caron' RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS reponse

questions.question: Quel studio a produit le film Fracture ?
Combien de films de science-fiction ont ete produits par Lumiere Studios ?
questions.cypher: MATCH (f:Film)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(:Studio {name:'Lumiere Studios'}), (f)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(:Genre {name:'Science-fiction'}) RETURN count(f) AS reponse

questions.question: Lea Vidal et Aicha Benali ont-elles joue dans le meme film ? Si oui, lequel ?
questions.cypher: MATCH (:Person {name:'Lea Vidal'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(f:Film)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(:Person {name:'Aicha Benali'}) RETURN f.name AS reponse
